environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. Security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080. No reverse proxy or middleware between the ELB and the Flask application. The ELB performs TCP-level health checks only. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume with default permissions.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP mode, port 8080 passthrough
